description: Independent analytic golden: orthogonal integer-bin sinusoids, periodic Hann, 2-second epochs. Each squared amplitude contributes A^2/2 variance. Hann spreads a sinusoid only to its immediate neighboring bins (0.5 Hz apart), all inside the configured line/high-frequency bands. Therefore line ratio = 100/536 and high-frequency ratio = 136/536. Values below are not generated by the implementation under test.
